title: Noether's Degree Bound β(G) ≤ |G| for Arbitrary Finite Groups
problemStatement: Sharpness (lower bound) of the optimal degree bound for the symmetric group Sₙ: prove the top elementary symmetric polynomial eₙ is transcendental over the subalgebra R[e₁,…,e_{n-1}], hence eₙ ∉ R[e₁,…,e_{n-1}], so β(Sₙ) ≥ n (and β(Sₙ) = n with the parent oq-02 upper bound).

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: proved β(Sₙ) ≥ n (sharpness) — eₙ transcendental over and not in R[e₁,…,e_{n-1}]; 0 axioms, 0 sorries, verified.
builtItems: esymm_top_transcendental_over_lower (Hilbert14OQ02OQ01.lean): eₙ transcendental over R[e₁,…,e_{n-1}] via AlgebraicIndependent.transcendental_adjoin at the top Fin index
esymm_top_not_mem_adjoin_lower (Hilbert14OQ02OQ01.lean): eₙ ∉ R[e₁,…,e_{n-1}] — the sharp lower bound β(Sₙ) ≥ n (needs [Nontrivial R])
esymm_lower_totalDegree_lt: each lower generator eⱼ₊₁ has total degree < n
beta_sharp_witness: capstone — eₙ symmetric, homogeneous of degree exactly n, not generated by lower elementary symmetrics
esymm_algebraicIndependent / esymm_isHomogeneous: self-contained re-proofs of the two parent facts used
insights: Sharpness of β(Sₙ)=n is a one-line specialisation of AlgebraicIndependent.transcendental_adjoin (a member of an alg-indep family is transcendental over the subalgebra of the others) applied to the top index of e₁,…,eₙ.
The parent oq-02 already supplied the needed hypothesis (algebraic independence of e₁,…,eₙ) — its optimal-NUMBER fact powers the optimal-DEGREE lower bound here.
Transcendence over a subalgebra B implies non-membership because every element of B is algebraic over B (isAlgebraic_algebraMap); this needs Nontrivial of the carrier, hence [Nontrivial R].
Index juggling: family over Fin (m+1), top index Fin.last m, lower indices Set.range Fin.castSucc; image of lower indices = lower esymm set via Set.range_comp + Fin.coe_castSucc.
mathlibGaps: No direct Mathlib lemma Transcendental B a → a ∉ B; routed through isAlgebraic_algebraMap which requires Nontrivial of the (sub)algebra carrier (no automatic carrier-Nontrivial instance for adjoin) — supplied manually via nontrivial_of_ne.
nextSteps: Upgrade the witness β(Sₙ) ≥ n to a statement over ALL degree-<n invariants: prove every symmetric poly of total degree < n is a polynomial in e₁,…,e_{n-1} (eₙ-degree of FTSP preimage = 0). Filed as open question oq-01.
